verdictRule: verdict=pass 的语义是：qa/constraints.json 的全部 81 条约束都被真实执行过，并且每一条的实际结果都与清单的预期一致（finding 类约束的预期就是「审计预期它不成立」，因此它们 FAIL 才是 pass）。quality 三闸门 complexity / crap / coverage 仍然是 FAIL，已原样记录在 gates 与 findings 里，不是本次 QA 的失败项，也没有被修饰成 PASS。；增补（第 5 阶段，no-root 维度）：同一条规则适用于第 1 阶段新增的 23 条 NR-*/MRG-02（NR-01…NR-21、NR-06b、MRG-02），合计 104 条；23 条全部配对（Q300-Q322/Q330）。其中 1 条复现出的实际行为与清单预期不一致（NR-06：agent 在干净 HOME + 缺失 -c 文件时 exit 1，清单写的是静默回退不崩），按本规则记 verdict=violated 并新增 finding NF-01；原有 81 条一个字段都没改。
summary: 81/81 条约束全部在真实构建产物上逐条复跑：76 条实测与清单预期一致，4 条 na（前端 / 容器部署 / 纯 CPU 降级 / 防火墙），1 条 unverifiable（合流方案 M1–M9 的答案属于第 6 阶段产出）。三条第 1 阶段声称的缺陷全部被独立复现：GET /api/audit-logs 恒 500、天级 90 天历史永不返回、jobs.pid 从不落库。另记 16 条产品问题（含一条被 500 掩盖的第二个缺陷：审计 COUNT 语句一个参数都没绑）与 9 条清单自身的不精确。产品本身不健康：硬阈值下 complexity 21/316、crap 45/316（maxCRAP 552）、行覆盖率 20.7%。增补（第 5 阶段 no-root 维度）：23 条 NR-* 约束在真实 release 二进制的干净状态上复跑并逐条独立复推；作者脚本的 23/23 PASS 可复现，但其中两条结论经不起对抗性检查——agent 在干净 HOME + 缺失 -c 文件时是 exit 1（不是「被 timeout 收掉」；harness 的 NR6 PASS 是假阳性，判据取的是 grep 的退出码），以及 NR-21 的证据量的是配置路径而非 env-only 那条（补齐后成立）。新增 finding：NF-01、NF-02（install-agent.sh:80 的 pkill）。核心结论不变：server/agent/TUI 确实能以 uid 3000、零 capability、零 HOME 外写入跑起来。

findings.title: agent started with a missing -c file dies immediately (exit 1) when $HOME/.config is absent - and the no-root harness reports this as PASS
findings.impact: The audit's no-root conclusion 'the agent does not crash when its config file is missing; it falls back silently and keeps running' is wrong for the very scenario the checklist constructs: a fresh user with a clean HOME. Copying a system unit's ExecStart (`-c /etc/clusterscope/agent.yaml`), or any deployment where $HOME/.config has not been created yet, gives a process that prints one INFO line and then exits 1 - no dashboard node, no metrics, no retry loop. In addition the operator is told nothing about the real cause: the error names $HOME/.config/node_id, never the missing config file.
findings.rootCause: crates/agent/src/config_loader.rs:9-11 silently substitutes AgentConfig::default() when the -c path does not exist (server_addr=http://localhost:50051, node_id=None, node_id_file=$HOME/.config/node_id). Then config_loader.rs:40 creates only the log dir ($HOME/.local/state/clusterscope-agent) - it does not create the parent of node_id_file. crates/agent/src/node_identity.rs:27 then fails with 'Failed to write node identity to "..."/No such file or directory (os error 2)' and the process exits 1. Note the asymmetry with the server: crates/server/src/main.rs:193 bails with 'Config file not found: <path>', so the two binaries disagree about missing config files.
repro: cd /public/tianyuyang/code/ClusterScope-review/gh-line
H=/tmp/nr-f01; rm -rf $H; mkdir -p $H
env HOME=$H timeout 8 ./target/release/clusterscope-agent -c /etc/clusterscope/agent.yaml; echo exit=$?   # -> exit=1
mkdir -p $H/.config && env HOME=$H timeout 8 ./target/release/clusterscope-agent -c /etc/clusterscope/agent.yaml; echo exit=$?   # -> exit=124 (survives)
env HOME=$H ./target/release/clusterscope-agent -c /tmp/definitely-absent.yaml 2>&1 | tail -3   # error names node_id, not the config file
findings.harnessNote: qa/harness/no-root-checks.sh:171-177 decides NR6 with `grep -q 'ClusterScope Agent starting'` and never reads the agent's exit status; the greeting line is printed before the crash, so the check passed while the process was already dead. Its own doc (qa/no-root.qa.md NR6) records 'exit 124 = killed by timeout' because a later `$?` in that file corresponds to the grep, not to the agent. Fix the check to assert the exit status (124 under timeout = still running) before changing any conclusion.
findings.verdictNote: This does NOT weaken NR-06b (the log dir really is created, Q306) and it does not affect the systemd --user path from install-agent.sh, which pre-creates ~/.config/clusterscope (lines 30/43) and therefore survives - see nr-verify4 variant e.

findings.title: F5 跑完会临时把操作者自己的 ~/.config/systemd/user/clusterscope-agent.service 换成仓库版——本轮我的脚本在两次 harness 之间覆盖了它，已逐字节还原（MainPID 未变）
findings.impact: F5 的做法是『备份现有同名 unit → 把仓库 unit 拷进 ~/.config/systemd/user/ → enable --now → 最后还原』。这个备份/还原本身是对的（每次跑完都还原），但两次 harness 之间如果还有别的脚本往同一个路径写同名 unit，操作者的那份就会被覆盖、且下一次 F5 会把『被覆盖后的版本』当成原样备份。本轮就发生了：我给 F5 段做独立复跑时把仓库 unit 拷了进去（我的 verify2 脚本），随后那次 harness 的备份/还原把仓库版还原成『原样』。收尾审计时发现 ~/.config/systemd/user/clusterscope-agent.service 是 809 字节的仓库版，而常驻实例原本那份是 269 字节（绝对路径、无描述后缀、无 %h）。已用我事先抓取的逐字节副本还原：size 809→269、cmp 一致、FragmentPath 指向原路径、ExecStart 回到 /public/tianyuyang/.local/bin/clusterscope-agent -c /public/tianyuyang/.config/clusterscope/agent.yaml、MainPID 266643 全程不变、is-active=active。
findings.note: 运行时未受影响（MainPID 没变、进程从未重启），缺的是机器上的持久化状态与操作者原状不一致。给后续阶段的提醒：跑 F5（或任何会写 ~/.config/systemd/user/clusterscope-agent.service 的手工复跑）之前先自己存一份逐字节副本，跑完用 cmp 核对；若要把流程写进文档，建议 F5 在还原后加一条 cmp -s 断言（现在它在文件原本就存在时已经断言了，但对『两次 harness 之间被改过』这种情况无能为力）。
findings.repro: 对比 qa/evidence/no-root-fixes-phase5-install-and-units.txt 的 J 段（我装入仓库 unit）与 K 段（逐字节还原核对），以及 F5 证据里的『还原：… 与安装前逐字节一致』断言；收尾审计时的尺寸 809 vs 269 记录在本条。

checklistDiscoveries.title: The shipped system units also depend on postgresql.service, which does not exist on a HOME-PostgreSQL node
checklistDiscoveries.detail: deploy/server.service:3 `After=network.target postgresql.service redis.service`. redis is unused by the code (redis_url is declared at crates/common/src/config.rs:66 and defaulted at :101, never read). postgresql.service is a distro unit name; on this cluster PostgreSQL 16.4 was compiled into HOME (no systemd unit at all: /lib/systemd/system/postgresql.service absent). So the system-unit path is doubly unworkable here: uninstallable without root (NR-15) and dependent on services this cluster does not run.

checklistDiscoveries.title: README has a second docker promise (line 57) that the NR-10 table does not classify
checklistDiscoveries.detail: README:57 'PostgreSQL | v16+(server 必需;可用 deploy/docker-compose.yml 一键起)' and README:337 (deploy/ listing includes docker-compose) make the same promise as :87 but more strongly, and neither is in the stage-1 classification table. Both fail for the same reason (no docker/docker-compose, no egress) - the failure mode is already recorded, only the per-line reconciliation (NR-10) was incomplete.

checklistDiscoveries.title: The no-root harness records evidence in gauntlet-out/ (gitignored) and deletes its per-check logs
checklistDiscoveries.detail: qa/harness/no-root-checks.sh writes to $R/gauntlet-out/qa/evidence and its cleanup trap removes /tmp/nr-checks/*.log, so the raw logs behind each NR line (agent-default-path.log, server-bare.log, ...) do not survive the run: only the one-line PASS/FAIL summary and no-root-server.log remain. Reproducibility therefore rests on re-running the script, not on archived raw output. This addendum's harness (qa/harness/nr-verify*.sh) writes its raw output to qa/evidence/ instead, which is committed.
